column1: # Hook-test suite weights (issue #2207). Read by .github/scripts/run-hook-tests.sh --shard i/n,
# which splits the pool and the serial group by weight: suites in descending weight go greedily
# Format: one row per suite, <seconds><TAB><path>, sorted with LC_ALL=C by path. Seconds are
# macOS wall seconds. A malformed row is ignored with one warning. A suite with no row gets the
# median row weight of this file (1 when the file has no rows).
# Source: full CI run 43120954884 (main, 2026-11-11), the slowest 30 suites of each macOS shard
# (hook-tests-macos-shard 1/2 and 2/2 job logs). Those 60 suites carry most of the measured time.
# Regenerate: run a full suite with --timing-file, which writes every suite's row, then rewrite
# the rows as <seconds><TAB><path> and sort them with LC_ALL=C sort -t TAB -k2,2.
